class.name: OpenXrSpatialFilterArchetype
class.brief_description: Structure that filters on an archetype.
class.description: An instance of this structure can be used as the [code]next[/code] parameter of the method [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.query_snapshot] to filter the snapshot by archetype.

members.member: The archetype to filter on. The archetype must match an entry returned by [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.get_snapshot_archetypes] for this snapshot.
